broadcasts.message: normalize.js remains unchanged and correct: NFKC, lowercase, whitespace collapse, trim. All peers' implementations align with spec. Ready for final integration.
Tokenizer remains unchanged and correct: normalizes then extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes, preserving order. Ready for final integration.
Pipeline remains unchanged. Dependencies are consistent. Using Object.create(null) for safe frequency counting. Ready for further rounds.

private_memories.normalizer: Round 2: normalize.js is stable and meets spec. Peers have implemented tokenizer and pipeline correctly. No changes needed to normalize.js. Confirm collaboration. Keep faithful processing. Next rounds: watch for any peer requests that might violate spec (e.g., stopwords, stemming) and reject. My normalize.js is final unless spec changes.
private_memories.tokenizer: Round 2: tokenizer.js is stable and matches spec. normalize.js and pipeline.js are implemented by peers. No changes needed to tokenizer.js. Verified regex and order. Continue to monitor for integration issues.
private_memories.integrator: Round 2: Pipeline is stable. Dependencies confirmed: normalize.js and tokenizer.js are as expected. My pipeline.js uses Object.create(null) for frequencies to handle prototype names. No changes needed. Continue to maintain exact output shape. Watch for any peer changes in future rounds.
